stem_book: Which of the following molecules would have the lowest boiling point? (a) H₂O (b) H₂S (c) H₂Se (d) H₂Te
reason: key D H₂Te vs working H₂S: b.p. H₂O 100 °C > H₂Te −2 °C > H₂Se −41 °C > H₂S −60 °C; H₂Te has the HIGHEST b.p. of the hydrides after water
work: no H-bonding in H₂S/Se/Te → b.p. rises with size (van der Waals); smallest non-H-bonded = H₂S lowest
